comment: Optional dependencies for the local model tests in
tests/vector_search/local-rag.test.js. These are not in package.json
because gpt4all requires node-gyp native compilation and @xenova/transformers
pulls in the onnxruntime binaries, which together are slow and fragile to
install on the CI runner. The tests that need them are opt-in through
RUN_LOCAL_MODEL_TESTS, so CI never installs these.
